remarks: Experience the perfect blend of luxury and convenience with this stunning Leefair Ranch condo. This exceptional property features a great sunny southern exposure with three french doors leading to a magnificent large garden. Included in this home is a full dining room, eat in kitchen, large living room with fireplace, separate study or den, half bath, two spacious bedrooms and two full baths on main level. An open staircase leads to the lower level featuring an attractive family room with book cases, a full bath and laundry and vast potential for future finishing. Complete with a two car garage, this is a must-see for anyone seeking the best of New Canaan condo living
